Wrap option disabled preserves long lines without breaking

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<p>This is a long paragraph that should not be wrapped at all because wrapping is disabled.</p>"#;
    let options_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"wrap":false}"#).unwrap();
    let options: ConversionOptions = serde_json::from_value(options_json).unwrap();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone()));
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
